bibl.title: The deep sea is a major sink for microplastic debris

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: where the manufactured plastic that surveys cannot account for has gone, and whether deep-sea sediment holds it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: how abundant and how widespread microplastic contamination is across a range of deep-sea depths and locations
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: microplastic fibres in all 12 sediment cores and all four coral samples from three oceans, at up to four orders of magnitude greater abundance per unit volume than heavily contaminated surface water - and the demonstration that the one previous deep-sea survey found little because it did not count fibres
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: existence
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: accumulation of plastic microfibres on the deep-sea floor - a repository large enough to bear on the missing-plastic budget, and unsampled until now
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: sediment cores and coral specimens from seven cruises by two independent teams, density-separated with NaCl or Ludox-TM 40, picked under a binocular microscope and identified by FT-IR against a spectral library that had the investigators' own clothing and gloves added to it
span.term: sediment cores and coral specimens from seven cruises by two independent teams, density-separated with NaCl or Ludox-TM 40, picked under a binocular microscope and identified by FT-IR against a spectral library that had the investigators' own clothing and gloves added to it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a positively buoyant plastic floats when it enters the sea, and fouling by organisms and adherence of particles change its density over weeks to months until it sinks - so the compartment a plastic is found in is a function of how long it has been there
span.term: buoyancy reversed by what grows on the particle
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: surface tension and currents hold most plastic at the surface; colonisation, adherence to phytoplankton and aggregation into marine snow bind fibres into larger, faster-settling particles, which is how a fibre reaches 3500 m
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: dense shelf water cascading, coastal storms, offshore convection and saline subduction all move large volumes of particle-loaded water downslope, carrying a full spectrum of grain sizes together with litter and contaminants, and submarine canyons concentrate the flow
span.term: canyons as conduits for particle-loaded water
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the fibres are the most numerous particle type in shallow habitats, so a protocol that does not enumerate fibres returns a low number from sediment that contains many - the difference between the two deep-sea reports is a decision about what to write down, and the authors demonstrated it on split samples rather than arguing it
span.term: a recording rule deciding an abundance
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: no statistical comparison of abundance or composition between samples is possible - the authors name the lack of replicates, the small sample size and the methodological differences, and decline to make one
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the four-orders-of-magnitude comparison with surface water is qualitative, because surface waters and sediments are sampled by different methods
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether fibres dominate sediment and fragments dominate the surface is a real distribution or an artefact of sampling method cannot be determined at present
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the precise origin of individual microplastic debris cannot currently be established, although the polymer types point to diverse domestic and industrial sources
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the coral samples were never quantitative - fibres were not extracted exhaustively and only presence or absence was recorded
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: rayon, which the authors state is not a plastic, is included in the counts and supplies 56.9% of the fibres reported
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the 4 billion fibres per square kilometre figure is an extrapolation, offered on the most conservative estimates
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: few studies examine the biological effects of microplastics at all, so what this abundance implies for harm is not established here
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: particle-transport mechanisms carried from physical oceanography - cascading, convection, saline subduction, canyon funnelling and Taylor columns - to explain how a textile fibre reaches the abyssal floor
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: marine snow, a biological-oceanography construct for aggregated organic debris, used as the vehicle that makes a buoyant synthetic fibre settle
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: every preservation and processing fluid filtered through a 32 um sieve before use, and the fresh and salt water supplies sampled for an hour daily and screened for fibres
span.note: eliminates: the laboratory's own water as the source of the fibres - a fibre that arrived in the rinse would be indistinguishable from one that arrived from the seafloor · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the spectra of the actual waterproofs and laboratory gloves used during collection and processing added to the FT-IR reference library, so that a fibre shed from them would be identified as such rather than as an unknown polymer
span.note: eliminates: the investigators' own equipment as the source of the identified polymers - without the spectra in the library a glove fibre matches nothing and is simply an unmatched particle · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: all residue sediment checked for the larger plastic particles the previous deep-sea study described, not only for the fibres this study was looking for
span.note: eliminates: this protocol having simply traded one blind spot for another - the check asks whether the particles the other method counts were present and missed · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: two extraction methods used by two independent teams, with the specific gravities of the separating substances reported against each other - 1.2 for NaCl, 1.16 for Ludox
span.note: eliminates: either laboratory's separation chemistry as the source of the result, to the extent that a float separation is characterised by its density · outcome: partial
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: their own deep-sea samples split and run through both this protocol and the protocol of the one previous deep-sea study, rather than comparing published numbers
span.note: eliminates: a real difference between sites as the explanation of the disagreement with the previous report - the same sediment cannot differ from itself · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: damp filter paper exposed to the laboratory air whenever samples were open, as a check on airborne contamination during processing
span.note: eliminates: airborne microplastic fibres settling into the samples during processing - the whole finding is fibres in deep-sea sediment, and the laboratory air is the rival source · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: natural fibre clothing only, with 100% cotton coats and headwear and latex gloves, for all laboratory processing and for the JC76T cruise
span.note: eliminates: synthetic fibres shed from the handlers' own clothing, which would be indistinguishable from the microplastic being counted · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: FT-IR acceptance thresholds on the spectral quality index - 0.7 and above accepted, 0.6 to 0.7 inspected individually, below 0.6 rejected
span.note: eliminates: false polymer identifications from poor-quality FT-IR spectra, with the middle band inspected by hand rather than accepted or dropped wholesale · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
